nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
UniswapExchange.ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) internal view; whitelist/access gate using owner, tradeAddress, canSale and pairFor derived UNI pair.
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) public payable; mutates allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum without any reentrancy guard.
UniswapExchange.approve(address _spender,uint _value) public payable; writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
UniswapExchange.condition(address _from,uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale limits from init().
UniswapExchange.delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-only arbitrary delegatecall sink.
UniswapExchange.init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only configuration of sale limits.
UniswapExchange.batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) public payable; owner-only mass balance rewrite in an unbounded loop.
UniswapExchange.setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only update of the trade whitelist address.
UniswapExchange.pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) internal pure; computes pair address via keccak256.
UniswapExchange constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; mints supply, sets owner=msg.sender and infinite UNI allowance.
address private owner; privileged account gating delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and ensure().
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address bypassing the sale condition check.
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom.
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; per-address whitelist bypassing condition().
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale value set by init().
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale value set by init().
uint256 private _saleNum; max number of sales per address set by init().
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; token balances mutated in transferFrom and batchSend.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; spend approvals mutated in approve/transferFrom.
address constant UNI = 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D; router address checked in ensure().
uint public totalSupply; minted in the constructor.
uint constant public decimals = 18; used for scaling in init() and constructor.
msg.sender; externally controlled caller used for ownership checks and as the transferFrom allowance owner.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(); arbitrary external code executed in the contract storage context.
balanceOf[_from]-=_value and balanceOf[_to]+=_value in transferFrom; state mutation sequence with no reentrancy guard.
unbounded for-loop in batchSend crediting balanceOf[_to] and emitting duplicated Transfer events.

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into transferFrom from transfer().
transfer() delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender determines the allowance[_from][msg.sender] authorization path in transferFrom.
transferFrom relies on ensure() before mutating balances; the whitelist gate is bypassable.
transferFrom performs unchecked-style raw subtraction/addition of balanceOf via the unsafe operation.
transferFrom rewrites balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] for sale-rate limiting.
ensure() falls through to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address.
ensure() treats tradeAddress as a whitelisted bypass address.
ensure() consults canSale[_from] as a whitelist bypass.
ensure() derives the Uniswap pair via pairFor().
pairFor is called with hardcoded factory and WETH addresses related to the UNI constant.
condition() reads _minSale to bound sale value.
condition() reads _maxSale to bound sale value.
condition() reads _saleNum as the per-address sale cap.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary code.
delegate() executes a.delegatecall(b), an owner-controlled arbitrary delegatecall.
Parameter a is the target of the delegatecall, fully attacker/owner chosen.
Parameter b is the raw calldata forwarded into the delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner to reconfigure sale limits.
init() writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init() writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init() writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init() scales limits using decimals.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() runs the unbounded recipient loop performing balance arithmetic.
batchSend() subtracts the total from and adds _value to balanceOf entries.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before setting the whitelist address.
setTradeAddress() writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the entire supply to msg.sender.
The constructor sets the privileged owner state variable.
The constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] to the full supply.
The constructor grants an infinite allowance to the UNI router.
The constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
Parameter _to flows into transfer/transferFrom recipient.
Parameter _value flows into transfer/transferFrom amount.
Parameter _from is the address checked against the whitelist inside ensure().
Parameter _to is checked against owner inside ensure().
Parameter _value is forwarded to condition() from ensure().
Parameter _from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value drives the subtraction from allowance and balanceOf.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance mapping in approve().
Parameter _value is stored as the allowance amount in approve().
Parameter saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init().
Parameter token is scaled into _minSale by init().
Parameter maxToken is scaled into _maxSale by init().
Parameter _tos provides the recipients looped over in batchSend.
Parameter _value is multiplied by _tos.length to compute total credits.
Local total = _value * _tos.length feeds the balanceOf deduction.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
Local _to is used as the key when crediting balanceOf[_to] in batchSend.
Local _UNI pair address is compared against _from in the ensure() whitelist test.
